links.comparator_used: Prompt without the TNM classification rule (generic prompt relying on the model's built-in knowledge), tested with GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4
links.outcome: Accuracy of clinical TNM (T, N, M) category assignment from CT radiology reports
links.effect: The best accuracy was achieved by GPT-4 when presented with the TNM classification rule: 52.2% (T), 78.9% (N), 86.7% (M). The abstract gives no accuracy figures for the no-rule condition.
links.quote: It was beneficial to present the TNM classification rule to ChatGPT to improve the performance.

design_hint: prompt guardrails: including TNM classification rule in prompt
